title: COGNITIVE MODELS CAN REVEAL INTERPRETABLE VALUE TRADE-OFFS IN LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses on a multiple-choice polite speech task using experimental vignettes of socially sensitive situations, and fitting the response distributions to a Rational Speech Acts (RSA) cognitive model to quantify the trade-off between informational utility (truthfulness) and social utility (agreeableness/politeness).
